assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that a Net is composed of transition-place arcs and place-transition arcs, but it does not explicitly state the relationship between these arcs and transitions.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R7 is not supported by the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class or attribute to represent tokens in the model.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R12 is not fully supported. The model does not enforce that a Net has at least one Place.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a constraint or a method in the Net class to ensure at least one Place is added.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R13 is not supported. The model does not specify that a place-transition arc has exactly one transition as the destination.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a constraint or a method in the Arc class to ensure exactly one transition is the destination.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R14 is not supported. The model does not specify that a transition-place arc has exactly one transition as the source.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a constraint or a method in the Arc class to ensure exactly one transition is the source.
